# Healthline
> Trusted consumer health publisher offering medically reviewed information, condition guides, wellness advice, and health news.

Healthline publishes evidence-based articles, topic hubs, symptom and treatment explainers, nutrition guidance, mental health resources, and medically reviewed reference content for people managing everyday wellness and specific health conditions.

## Core Site
- [Home](https://www.healthline.com/): Main entry point for trusted medical information, wellness advice, and featured health content.
- [Health Topics Directory](https://www.healthline.com/directory/topics): Browse Healthline’s topic index covering conditions, symptoms, treatments, and wellness subjects.
- [FindCare](https://www.healthline.com/find-care): Provider discovery tool for finding doctors, specialists, and care options.
- [News](https://www.healthline.com/health-news): Health news coverage on research, public health, and medical developments.
- [Nutrition](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition): Nutrition hub with evidence-based articles on diets, foods, supplements, and healthy eating.
- [Medical Network](https://www.healthline.com/medical-network): Information about Healthline’s medical review process and expert contributors.

## Health Reference
- [Health Conditions](https://www.healthline.com/health): Broad health reference hub for diseases, symptoms, diagnostics, and treatments.
- [Symptoms](https://www.healthline.com/symptom): Symptom reference pages explaining possible causes and when to seek care.
- [Drugs & Supplements](https://www.healthline.com/drugs): Medication and supplement reference content, including uses and safety information.
- [Human Body Maps](https://www.healthline.com/human-body-maps): Interactive anatomy reference for body systems, organs, and structures.
- [Medical Tests](https://www.healthline.com/health/medical-tests): Guides to common medical tests, screenings, and diagnostic procedures.
- [Wellness](https://www.healthline.com/health/wellness): General wellness content focused on prevention, habits, and healthy living.

## Mental Health
- [Mental Health Hub](https://www.healthline.com/mental-health): Central resource for mental health conditions, therapy, coping, and self-care.
- [Anxiety](https://www.healthline.com/health/anxiety): Articles on anxiety symptoms, causes, diagnosis, and treatment options.
- [Depression](https://www.healthline.com/health/depression): Reference and support content about depression, symptoms, and treatment approaches.
- [Stress](https://www.healthline.com/health/stress): Guidance on recognizing stress and using practical coping strategies.
- [Therapy](https://www.healthline.com/health/therapy): Explanations of therapy types, benefits, and how treatment works.
- [Sleep](https://www.healthline.com/health/sleep): Sleep health information covering insomnia, sleep hygiene, and related disorders.

## Nutrition & Fitness
- [Nutrition Home](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition): Main nutrition section with diet reviews, food guides, and science-based explainers.
- [Weight Management](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/weight-loss): Articles on weight loss, metabolism, and sustainable eating strategies.
- [Healthy Eating](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/healthy-eating): Practical guidance on balanced diets, meal planning, and food choices.
- [Vitamins & Supplements](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/supplements): Evidence-based supplement guides covering benefits, risks, and dosage considerations.
- [Fitness](https://www.healthline.com/health/fitness-exercise): Exercise and movement content for strength, cardio, flexibility, and overall health.
- [Hydration](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/how-much-water-should-you-drink-per-day): Popular evidence-based guide to daily water intake and hydration needs.

## Chronic Conditions
- [Type 2 Diabetes](https://www.healthline.com/type-2-diabetes): Resource center for blood sugar management, treatment, and daily living.
- [Heart Health](https://www.healthline.com/heart-health): Cardiovascular health hub covering prevention, symptoms, and heart disease management.
- [Rheumatoid Arthritis](https://www.healthline.com/rheumatoid-arthritis): Information on symptoms, medications, flare management, and lifestyle adjustments.
- [Chronic Kidney Disease](https://www.healthline.com/ckd): CKD resource center with staging, treatment, and kidney health guidance.
- [COPD](https://www.healthline.com/copd): Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease information on symptoms, treatment, and breathing support.
- [Multiple Sclerosis](https://www.healthline.com/multiple-sclerosis): MS hub covering symptoms, therapies, and living with the condition.
- [Migraine](https://www.healthline.com/migraine): Migraine resource center with triggers, treatments, and symptom management.
- [Psoriasis](https://www.healthline.com/health/psoriasis): Reference content on psoriasis symptoms, treatment options, and skin care.

## Cancer & Serious Illness
- [Cancer Care](https://www.healthline.com/cancer-care): Cancer-focused hub with treatment, support, survivorship, and patient education content.
- [Breast Cancer](https://www.healthline.com/health/breast-cancer): Guides to symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, and living with breast cancer.
- [Lung Cancer](https://www.healthline.com/health/lung-cancer): Information on lung cancer types, symptoms, staging, and treatment.
- [Prostate Cancer](https://www.healthline.com/health/prostate-cancer): Reference content on screening, diagnosis, and treatment decisions.
- [Colorectal Cancer](https://www.healthline.com/health/colorectal-cancer): Educational articles on colorectal cancer symptoms, testing, and care.
- [Alzheimer's Disease](https://www.healthline.com/health/alzheimers-disease): Information for patients and caregivers on symptoms, progression, and support.

## Women’s & Men’s Health
- [Women's Health](https://www.healthline.com/womens-health): Women’s health hub covering reproductive health, hormones, and life stages.
- [Pregnancy](https://www.healthline.com/health/pregnancy): Pregnancy reference content on symptoms, fetal development, and prenatal care.
- [Menopause](https://www.healthline.com/health/menopause): Guides to menopause symptoms, hormone changes, and treatment options.
- [Sexual Health](https://www.healthline.com/health/sexual-health): Educational content on sexual wellness, STIs, and reproductive health.
- [Men's Health](https://www.healthline.com/mens-health): Men’s health hub covering fitness, sexual health, and preventive care.
- [Testosterone](https://www.healthline.com/health/low-testosterone): Information on low testosterone symptoms, causes, and treatment.

## Digestive, Skin & Everyday Health
- [Digestive Health](https://www.healthline.com/health/digestive-health): Content on gut health, GI conditions, symptoms, and digestive wellness.
- [IBS](https://www.healthline.com/health/irritable-bowel-syndrome): Irritable bowel syndrome guides covering symptoms, triggers, and treatment.
- [GERD](https://www.healthline.com/health/gerd): Reference content on acid reflux symptoms, causes, and management.
- [Skin Health](https://www.healthline.com/health/skin): Skin care and dermatology content on common conditions and treatments.
- [Eczema](https://www.healthline.com/health/eczema): Articles on eczema symptoms, triggers, and treatment strategies.
- [Allergies](https://www.healthline.com/health/allergies): Information on seasonal, food, and environmental allergies.

## News, Perspectives & Community
- [Health News](https://www.healthline.com/health-news): Timely reporting on studies, policy, outbreaks, and public health trends.
- [Original Series](https://www.healthline.com/health-news/tag/original-series): Editorial series and feature packages on major health topics.
- [You’re Not Alone](https://www.healthline.com/health/youre-not-alone): First-person stories and community-centered mental health perspectives.
- [Bezzy](https://www.healthline.com/health/bezzy): Community platform connecting people around chronic and mental health conditions.
- [Editorial Process](https://www.healthline.com/health/editorial-process): Overview of Healthline’s standards for sourcing, review, and content quality.
- [Fact-Checking Process](https://www.healthline.com/health/fact-checking-process): Explanation of how Healthline verifies claims and maintains accuracy.
